scope: STATIC ONLY: textual contracts and lexical checks, not native PowerShell, WPF, UAC or AD execution.

checks.name: Shared monitor uses a synchronized table and concurrent event queue
Worker messages are sanitized before enqueue
Stage snapshot is assigned atomically, not a partially edited live object
Cancellation and admission share the same monitor lock
Cancellation tested before mutation admission
UI event drain is bounded and uses TryDequeue
Queue worker STA, same telemetry object and 300 second watchdog
Read workers remain MTA unless explicitly changed
Active QueueAction cannot be replaced
Live events are drained before waiting for completion
Final events are drained before success callback
Mutating timeout keeps worker registry until actual completion
Mutating timeout never directly invokes BeginStop
Explicit queue stop fences, suppresses callbacks and keeps monitoring
Timeout is labeled uncertain, not a confirmed failure
Uncertain summary does not announce Windows completion
Late result cannot overwrite the timeout
Safety reset blocked while timed-out worker remains live
15 second audit heartbeat contains current stage
UAC uses STA and announces before shell launch
Helper visible, exits detected before credentials, 120 second connection guard
Verified PID before credential send
Response waiting is polled and never kills the helper
Credential transmission follows mutation admission
RenameComputer gates admission before native write
AddToDomain gates admission before native write
MoveComputer gates admission before native write
Move finally always attempts original protection restoration
Rename completion gated before following AD move
Local source avoids a network ping
Worker log sink available before module import
Worker uses only shared data, no WPF dispatcher access
Required telemetry functions included in exported source
tests/Run-ProgressTests.ps1 BOM, CRLF, conservative delimiter checks
tools/Diagnostic-Rename.ps1 BOM, CRLF, conservative delimiter checks
tools/Build-GP.ps1 BOM, CRLF, conservative delimiter checks
Windows tests exercise real timers but never start GP
Master and build runners include the new suite
Diagnostic collects no process arguments or mutations
Diagnostic explicitly avoids claiming no operation still active
